skill.nirncraft.acrobatics.desc: Jumping higher and farther, and landing from great heights without harm.
skill.nirncraft.cooking.desc: Cooking meals at a cooking pot that heal, refresh and fortify whoever eats them.
skill.nirncraft.mysticism.desc: The school of the unseen: telekinesis, dispelling, reflecting and absorbing magic, Mark and Recall, interventions and levitation.
skill.nirncraft.polearm.desc: Fighting with spears, halberds and glaives: long reach, sweeping blows and pinning thrusts.
skill.nirncraft.riding.desc: Riding horses faster and farther, and fighting from the saddle.
tooltip.nirncraft.meal: Cooked with Cooking %s: restores more when eaten
